aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.title: How to Write Effective Prompts
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.beSpecificDe: Include file paths, function names, and expected behavior. Vague prompts lead to vague results.
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.beSpecificEx:
Bad: "Fix the bug"
Good: "Fix the TypeError in src/utils/parser.ts:42 where parseConfig() returns undefined when the input JSON has nested arrays"
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.provideConte: Explain what you've already tried, what the expected behavior is, and any constraints.
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.setCriteriaD: Tell the AI how to verify its work is done. This prevents incomplete implementations.
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.setCriteriaE: "Acceptance criteria: 1) All existing tests pass 2) New unit test covers the edge case 3) No TypeScript errors"
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.useExamplesD: Show input/output examples when the expected behavior is complex.
aiAssistant.coaching.prompt.iteratePromp: If the first result isn't right, refine your prompt rather than starting over. Reference what was wrong.
aiAssistant.coaching.skill.title: Skill Usage Guide
aiAssistant.coaching.skill.planningDesc: Use /plan or brainstorming skills before complex implementations. Break large tasks into steps.
aiAssistant.coaching.skill.implementatio: Use TDD skills for reliable code. Delegate to executor agents for multi-file changes.
aiAssistant.coaching.skill.debuggingDesc: Use systematic debugging skills. Provide error messages, stack traces, and reproduction steps.
aiAssistant.coaching.skill.verificationD: Always verify before claiming done. Run tests, check types, lint. Use verification skills.
aiAssistant.coaching.criteria.title: Setting Acceptance Criteria
aiAssistant.coaching.criteria.functional: Define what the code should DO. Include edge cases and error handling expectations.
aiAssistant.coaching.criteria.qualityDes: TypeScript compiles, tests pass, no lint errors, no regressions.
aiAssistant.coaching.criteria.templateCo:
Acceptance Criteria:
1. [ ] Functional: [describe expected behavior]
2. [ ] Tests: [new tests + existing tests pass]
3. [ ] Types: pnpm tsc --build . passes
4. [ ] Lint: pnpm lint passes
5. [ ] No regressions in [related features]
